title: Serino 2015 peri-hand PPS Experiment 3
citation: Serino, A., Noel, J. P., Galli, G., Canzoneri, E., Marmaroli, P., Lissek, H., & Blanke, O. (2015). Body part-centered and full body-centered peripersonal space representations. Scientific Reports, 5, 18603.
notes: Peri-hand branch of the Serino body-part mapping series. This binaural proxy uses continuous pink noise and a derived 4-s path (0.88 m / 0.22 m/s), with a separate 100-ms software tail to contain the last tactile cue. The right-side 0.35-m hand offset and distance-to-SOA origin are explicit assumptions. Digital peak normalization at 0.9 plus inverse-square attenuation is a proxy policy; it does not reproduce the reported speaker SPL envelope or establish calibration. Exact hand side, original WAV/envelope files, numerical timing origin and block/order rules remain caveats.

reference_parameters.software_trial_padding_basis: Derived containment only: post=max(0,4000+100-4000)=100 ms after the four-second software sound. This tail is not a reported trial margin or the reported shuffled 500-700-ms ITI.
reference_parameters.soa_values_ms_basis: Derived proxy: elapsed_ms=(93-distance_cm)/22*1000, rounded to whole milliseconds, for [93,71,50,27,5] cm gives [0,1000,1955,3000,4000]. The primary Methods report distances and 22 cm/s, but do not report this numerical SOA table or establish this exact sound-onset origin.
reference_parameters.loudness_policy_basis: Explicit digital proxy: peak 0.9 with inverse-square attenuation. No physical SPL or original 55-to-70-dB envelope equivalence is claimed.
reference_parameters.analog_apparatus_recreation: Original near/far speakers are modeled as the reported moving-sound trajectory in the binaural renderer.

body_anchor_frame.hand_side: not reported; profile uses a right-side positive-x convention

remaining_caveats: exact original pink-noise WAV/noise seed is not reported
exact SoundForge envelope files are not provided beyond exponential direction and dB endpoints
exact hand side is not stated for Experiment 3
exact trial-order randomization, block count, and response timeout/window are not reported

provenance.field: proxy duration, SOA and level policy
provenance.source: Scientific Reports DOI 10.1038/srep18603, Methods Experiment 3 and Supplementary Methods: 22 cm/s and five hand-relative distances. Software duration=(0.93-0.05)/0.22=4 s; SOA=(0.93-distance_m)/0.22. The exact sound-onset origin is unreported. A separate 100-ms tail contains the software tactile cue; digital peak 0.9/inverse-square and right-side hand offset are explicit proxy choices. Native generation sidecars bind actual source, renderer, resources and output hashes.
Scientific Reports Experiment 3 reports five distances: 5, 27, 50, 71, and 93 cm.
Methods report 208 trials for Experiment 3 with 16 repetitions.

Manual review records that the hand was placed at shoulder width and the near/far speaker line was hand-relative. The profile encodes this with a positive-x cartesian offset and keeps the exact hand side as an unresolved caveat.
